products-heading-p: ElFahham is a unique destination that combines the magic of nature and fine taste, as we offer a variety of grains, nuts high-quality spices, and fresh agricultural crops with competitive prices.
about-heading-p: ElFahham Company was established in 1972, where we, the sons ofthe late Saad Abu Bakr Al-Fahham, began trading in agricultural crops, limiting ourselves to local work only at the beginning.After seven years, we worked hard to develop production capacity and purchase the latestequipment and machines to obtain high-quality results in the fastest time. In 1990, we expanded our areas of work and introduced more products to the Egyptian market.
story-heading: The Turning Point in the History of ElFahham
story-heading-p-one: At the beginning of the 2000s, we decided to expand our activity and increase our efforts to meet the needs of the Egyptian market.
story-heading-p-two: We opened a new headquarters for sorting, packing and exporting rice. We were also able to provide luxurious, high-quality rice to the Egyptian market.
story-heading-p-three: In 2012, the company became a famous brand under the name “ElFahham for Processing, Importing and Exporting Agricultural Crops.”
Success-p-one: Mr. Hesham Mohamed Elfahham had a pivotal role in building and developing the company’s business on his own, away from the family business. The company enhanced its production capacity in an unprecedented way. The company now has more than 7 production lines, with a daily production of 500 tons.
Success-p-two: We also created storage spaces with a capacity of 20,000 tons, in addition to cold storage areas equipped with the highest quality.
Success-p-three: ElFahham Company has become among the largest import and export companies for various goods.
Success-p-four: We have exported more than 30 thousand tons of white beans, Egyptian beans, sesame, lentils and spices to many countries, and imported many products needed by the Egyptian market such as condiment such as black pepper and nuts.
challenges-p-one: The biggest challenge facing us has always been to search for new and innovative strategies that achieve customer satisfaction and increase their confidence. We always work to identify customer requirements and strive to meet their goals, and we have actually been able to gain customer confidence with our unique and innovative methods and our constant keenness to ensure high quality.
mission-p: We always strive to achieve the difficult equation, which is combining high quality with competitive prices. Fortunately, we were able to achieve this equation using the latest international technologies.
goal-p: To become a global leader in the field of importing, exporting, processing and packaging agricultural crops, and to be the first choice for customers looking for quality, trust and excellence.
team-p: A professional work team is the key to success. We have a work team characterized by dedication to work, professionalism, strong will, and a cooperative atmosphere, so it is the secret of our success.
